_comment: Hand-authored catalogue entries for commands tldr-pages does not document, merged into
command-catalogue.json by scripts/generate-command-catalogue.ps1. These are NOT tldr-pages
content and are not covered by its CC-BY-SA licence; the generator marks every entry from
this file with "o": "ntilde" in the output so the asset's attribution header stays honest.
Keep this list short. An entry belongs here only when the command is one the plan or a user
report names and tldr has no page for it - not as a place to second-guess tldr's wording.

entries.d: List the processes running on the local computer.

e.d: Show processes matching a name, without the .exe suffix
Show a single process by its process id
Show the ten processes using the most memory
Stop every process matching a name
Include the owning user (requires an elevated session)

entries.d: List the Windows services on the local computer.

e.d: List every service with its status
Show a single service by name
List only the services that are running
Find services by their display name
Restart a service (requires an elevated session)
Show the services that depend on a service
